original_lines: save_temporary_scope_as = faith # used by loc below
# This is just to make the player requirements a bit clearer
# Show usage of free holy site action, if appropriate
# always leave one slot for a player to adopt/create
# BARONY = the candidate holy site's barony title, in faith scope
# One created or adopted holy site per de jure kingdom
# As above, with the player-facing requirement line. Root must be the acting character.
# The acting character is the scope, and on the puppet action path that is the puppet
# A puppet standing in for a missing Head of Faith defers to its puppeteer
# Substitute authority for a faith with no head of faith: a realm priest puppet plus piety standing.
# puppet: errors on non-playable characters, so we only check playable ones and tooltips never run it
# Actor opinion is delivered by special_parameters; the syncretic trigger checks the doctrine.
# Christ-as-adopted-human theme: divine sonship attainable through grace, not blood.
# Rigid orthodoxy is precisely what rejects adoptionism's grace-not-blood sonship.
# Arbitrary parameters where bool types can be checked with the trigger: 'has_doctrine_parameter'
# When can this tenet be picked when choosing tenets?
# When tenets should refer to other selected tenets when creating a new faith (e.g. for mutually exclusive tenets), use:
# The "selected_tenets" list is the list of tenets currently selected in the UI. (It might be different from the tenets in
# the faith, since the player can change multiple tenets when creating a faith.)
#	actor: the character picking doctrines (usually Head of Faith / Head of Rite). Can be null
# Can this tenet be picked as personal tenet by the character in scope?
# special structure for value overrides. See _doctrine_types.info for in-depth description.
# Playable characters that choose this tenet as personal get this modifier.
# Playable characters that choose this tenet as personal have these flags.
# Check them with the has_personal_tenet_flag trigger, localize with doctrine_parameter_ prefix.
# What is the parent faith of this Rite? If a faith has no scripted Rites a dynamic one with the same name will be created instead
# if no parent faith is defined, the Rite will not be generated from history and will only be available via the create_rite_from_type effect.
# you can still specify parent faith overrides in specific bookmarks (see below), starting the game in those dates will generate the rite from history
# List of tenets associated with this Rite. If this is a faith's scripted main Rite, these are the faith's
# effective core tenets; do not duplicate them in the faith type.
# List of doctrines associated with this Rite. Rite doctrines override parent-religion and faith doctrines from the
# same doctrine group. Faith doctrines from otherwise unfilled groups are added to the instantiated main Rite.
# Put doctrine choices intrinsic to the whole faith on the faith type and Rite-specific choices here.
# If the faith has no scripted main Rite, tenets and tenet_selection_pair seed its dynamically created main Rite.
# If the faith has a scripted main Rite, define its core tenets on that Rite instead; the Rite's tenets override these.
# Faith doctrines are additive to a scripted main Rite. The faith doctrine is added when the Rite and parent religion
# have not already filled its doctrine group; a doctrine on the Rite in the same group takes precedence.
# Keep doctrines intrinsic to every Rite of the faith here. Put Rite-specific doctrine choices on the individual Rite.
# For a faith with no scripted main Rite, these doctrines seed the dynamically created main Rite.
# If the faith is supposed to have a specific Rite as its main Rite, specify its key here.
# If it changes between start dates, use faith history to set the dated main Rites and document those mappings
# in a comment in the faith definition. The scripted main Rite owns core tenets and Rite-specific doctrines, while
# faith-intrinsic doctrines may remain additive in the faith definition.
# hostility override map depending on the relation between the other faith and this one.
# See the "hostility" section for more info
# same_religion: How hostile is this faith towards other faiths of the same religion?
# How hostile is this faith towards other faiths of the same religion family, but not same religion?
# How hostile is this faith towards faiths from different religion families?
# hostility override map depending on whether the target faith has the given doctrine
# How hostile is this faith towards faith who they share Head of Faith with? Takes precedence over other hostility overrides.

# Since doctrines cannot modify other faith's views of us, only our view of others, all Christian faiths are given this special doctrine which makes them friendlier to Faiths with the Christian Syncretism tenet.
# We don't localise these because Adoptionists are supposed to be a bit of a surprise.

# Since doctrines cannot modify other faith's views of us, only our view of others, all Islamic faiths are given this special doctrine which makes them friendlier to Faiths with the Islamic Syncretism tenet.
# How long a ruler must wait between holy site actions, shared by the decisions and by holy site creation.
# Scope: character taking one of the holy site decisions.
# Cooldown in years, waived while the faith still has a free holy site action left. Decision cooldowns
# are evaluated with only the taking character in scope - no saved scopes - so this can read the faith
# but nothing about the selected holy site.
# After the cost is already waived, a decision effect runs this on the faith
RITE_CREATION_FERVOR_DISCOUNT_PER_MISSING_FERVOR = 1 # How much cheaper does creating a faith get per fervor below 100%? 1 means 1% per point
RITE_CREATION_FERVOR_DISCOUNT_MAX = 50 # What percentage does the discount cap out at? With these numbers, 0-50 fervor means a 50% discount. Above 50 means between 0% and 50% discount
RITE_CREATION_DIVERGENCE_FAITH_THRESHOLD = 100 # when creating a Rite, divergence values at or over this threshold will result in a Faith being created instead of a Rite
RITE_CREATION_PIETY_COST = 1.0	# Fixed cost how much piety it costs to branch off a Faith with new Rite
RITE_DIVERGENCE_HERETICAL_THRESHOLD = 65 # Divergence above which a Rite is considered heretical
tenet_christian_syncretism_desc: "纳匝肋人耶稣或许并非真神，但他仍是一位正直美善的人物。我们应当尊崇敬奉他的教导。"

doctrine_parameter_christian_syncretic_recipient_opinion_active: "与基督教[faiths|E]及其[counties|E]之间有$VALUE|=+0$的双向[opinion|E]加成"
tenet_islamic_syncretism_desc: "先知的圣训必定是明智且正义的，不论我们有什么其他疑虑，我们都必须听从他的思想与行为。"
doctrine_parameter_islamic_syncretic_actor_opinion_active: "与拥有$tenet_islamic_syncretism_name$[core_tenet|E]的[faiths|E]之间有$VALUE|=+0$的双向[opinion|E]加成"
doctrine_parameter_islamic_syncretic_recipient_opinion_active: "与伊斯兰教[faiths|E]及其[counties|E]之间有$VALUE|=+0$的双向[opinion|E]加成"

doctrine_pluralism_fundamentalist_desc: "我们的信仰是唯一真正的信仰，我们的经文是唯一正确的经文。对[ROOT.Faith.ReligiousText]的任何偏离都是彻底的亵渎。"

doctrine_pluralism_pluralistic_desc: "宣称神的意愿只有唯一一种正确的解读而且其他所有人的观点是错误的，这种观念是非常愚蠢的。我们每个人都有崇拜[ROOT.Faith.HighGodName]的自己的方式。"
